Claim: All 117 tasks in the separate proof-closure cohort are independently certified.
Supporting data: 117 tasks from 39 graph IDs x 3 parameter pairs
Evidence type: independent post-hoc mathematical and clausal certificate verification
Scope: separate proof-closure cohort with zero exact task-key overlap with the historical 207 tasks
Limitations: Not historical timed solver coverage; checker is not formally verified
Permitted wording: A later independent proof-closure study certifies all 117 tasks in its separate cohort.
Prohibited overstatement: The historical benchmark solvers proved all 117 tasks within the 30-second cap, or all 207 benchmark tasks are certified.

Claim: The historical benchmark contains 1,242 method-level rows over 207 graph-parameter tasks.
Supporting data: 69 graph instances x 3 distinct parameter pairs = 207 tasks; 207 tasks x 6 methods = 1,242 rows
Limitations: Parameter pairs are problem configurations rather than repeated measurements; graph cohort is not a random sample of all graphs
Permitted wording: The benchmark records 1,242 method-level rows across 207 graph-parameter tasks.
Prohibited overstatement: The benchmark contains 1,242 independent instances or three repeated measurements per task.

Claim: SAT and ILP have different proof/timeout profiles; no universal winner is established.
Scope: finite 69-graph cohort crossed with three parameter configurations
Limitations: Right censoring; the same graph instances recur across parameter tasks and methods
Permitted wording: On this workload, proof coverage and timeouts differ by method and family.
Prohibited overstatement: SAT is generally faster or superior.

Claim: The Phase 3A.4 diagnostic cohort had 30 arms, 27 completed attempts, 9 OPT, 21 UNKNOWN, 0 UNSAT, 0 parent timeouts.
Limitations: Soft conflict threshold was nominal, not hard
Permitted wording: The cohort produced these explicitly reconciled outcomes.

Claim: At fixed graph, h, k and U, the three original path labels build identical formulas.
Limitations: Does not compare full search lifecycles
Permitted wording: Under identical fixed inputs, formulas match across path labels.
Prohibited overstatement: Earlier span-dependent sizes prove different encoder quality.

Claim: Distance-2 processing was unique in the audited cohort.
Permitted wording: No duplicate distance-2 processing was observed in the audited cohort.
Prohibited overstatement: No redundancy can ever exist for all graphs.

Claim: Threshold reduces clauses/literals but increases variables in the tested models.
Supporting data: ER-60 exact counts; 39.0–43.0% clause and 54.9–58.0% literal reductions in Phase 3F
Permitted wording: Threshold reduced clauses and literals in the tested cohort at the cost of selector variables.

Claim: Phase 3F is inconclusive for broad external validity.
Supporting data: 48 scheduled; 42 SAT; 6 parent timeouts; all six on ER_40_p0.30_seed100
Limitations: Only four families and one parameter pair; censored difficult graph
Permitted wording: The data support a restricted formula-size finding but not broad practical superiority.
Prohibited overstatement: Threshold is generally faster across graph families.

Claim: IPASIR-UP telemetry was materially intrusive and is closed.
Supporting data: connected control +~41%; threshold sampling timed out
Permitted wording: IPASIR-UP is unsuitable for ordinary performance comparison in this study.
Prohibited overstatement: The pilot measures unbiased solver behavior.
